question: In adults with a synthetic chronic condition, does Treatment A reduce the fictional biomarker compared with usual care?

studies.title: Synthetic randomized trial of Treatment A
studies.abstract: In this fictional randomized study of 240 adults, Treatment A reduced the fictional biomarker by 8 units versus 3 units with usual care at 12 weeks. Attrition was 18%, and the study was not powered for clinical outcomes.

studies.title: Synthetic observational study of Treatment A
studies.abstract: In this fictional cohort of 1,100 adults, Treatment A was associated with a 4-unit larger biomarker reduction after adjustment. Residual confounding and incomplete outcome capture were possible.
